'''Mónica Alicia Clapp Jiménez Labora''' is a mathematician at the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico|Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México]] (UNAM) known for her work in [[nonlinear partial differential equation]]s and [[algebraic topology]].

==Life and work==
Clapp was born in [[Mexico City]].<ref name=homepage>{{cite web|url=http://www.matem.unam.mx/fsd/mclapp|title=Mónica Clapp (Investigadora)|location=Instituto de Matemáticas|accessdate=Feb 2, 2015}}</ref> She graduated from UNAM in 1974. Clapp then graduated with her [[Ph.D]] from [[Heidelberg University]] in 1979, and has been a faculty member at UNAM since that time.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=75391|title=Mónica Clapp}}</ref>

Clapp has been an editor of the journals [[Boletín de la Sociedad Matemática Mexicana]] and [[Aportaciones Matemáticas]].<ref name=homepage/>

==Awards and honors==
In 2012, Clapp became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref> She is also a member of the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amc.mx/amc/membresia/MATEMATICAS2021.pdf|title=Mathematics section members|publisher=Mexican Academy of Sciences|year=2021|access-date=2022-11-18}}</ref>

In 2018, she received the [[National Prize for Arts and Sciences|National Prize for Sciences]] in the ''Physics, Mathematics, and Natural Sciences'' category, "for his outstanding contribution in the fields of nonlinear partial differential equations, variational and topological methods in nonlinear analysis, as well as algebraic topology."<ref name="unam2018">{{cite web | title=Premio Nacional de Ciencias y Artes, a tres académicos | website=Gaceta UNAM | date=2018-10-29 | url=https://www.gaceta.unam.mx/premio-nacional-de-ciencias-y-artes-a-tres-academicos/ | language=es | access-date=2025-01-31}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Mónica Clapp ha sido galardonada con el Premio Nacional de Ciencias 2018 | website=Instituto de Matemáticas, UNAM | url=https://www.matem.unam.mx/acerca-de/noticias/monica-clapp-ha-sido-galardonada-con-el-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-2018 | language=es | access-date=2025-01-31}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* Clapp, Mónica; Puppe, Dieter Invariants of the Lusternik-Schnirelmann type and the topology of critical sets. ''[[Transactions of the American Mathematical Society]]'' 298 (1986), no. 2, 603–620.
* Clapp, Mónica; Puppe, Dieter Critical point theory with symmetries. ''[[Crelle's Journal|Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik]]'' 418 (1991), 1–29.
* Bartsch, Thomas; Clapp, Mónica Critical point theory for indefinite functionals with symmetries. ''Journal of Functional Analysis'' 138 (1996), no. 1, 107–136.
* Castro, Alfonso; Clapp, Mónica The effect of the domain topology on the number of minimal nodal solutions of an elliptic equation at critical growth in a symmetric domain. ''Nonlinearity'' 16 (2003), no. 2, 579–590.
